assumptions: PUBLIC DEMONSTRATION DATA: cities, dates, costs and host arrangements are fictional planning examples, not anyone’s confirmed plans.
Example origin: Boston, Massachusetts. Confirm actual origin in your private state.
Example period: Christmas 2026 / New Year 2027. Dates are illustrative only.
Example accommodation costs zero, subject to host confirmation.
All transport ranges are planning estimates, NOT live fares or availability.
Rabbit care charged for every calendar day away, including departure and return.
Daily spending includes meals, local travel and activities; excludes normal home spending offset.

scenarios.name: Boston · both holidays
scenarios.route: Stay local from the example origin; MBTA and walking.
gates: Choose local company and holiday plans.
scenarios.note: Best fallback if budget or rabbit care blocks travel. Local spending is optional, not a cost of being away.

scenarios.name: Roanoke · Christmas
scenarios.route: BOS → ROA with connection, or long Northeast Regional rail journey; hosts/taxi for final mile.
gates: Confirm hosts' dates and airport/station pickup.
Reserve daily rabbit care; rabbit transport remains unverified.
scenarios.note: Illustrative flight range is return. Compare train separately on exact dates; do not assume rail saves money. Local New Year afterwards.

scenarios.name: Roanoke · Christmas by rail
scenarios.route: Boston South Station ↔ Roanoke by Northeast Regional; verify exact schedule and allow a long travel day each way.
gates: Confirm hosts' dates and airport/station pickup.
Reserve daily rabbit care; rabbit transport remains unverified.
scenarios.note: Rail range is a return planning allowance, not a holiday fare. Rabbit stays with daily care in the example origin. Confirm station pickup and journey tolerance.

scenarios.name: London · Christmas
scenarios.route: BOS ↔ London; airport rail on operating days, friend’s home as base.
gates: Confirm friend is available for Christmas.
Plan Dec 25 within walking distance or price a taxi.
Check passport, UK entry permission and employer overseas work policy.
scenarios.note: Christmas Day has no ordinary TfL service. Free lodging does not remove holiday transport constraints.

scenarios.name: Berlin · Christmas
scenarios.route: BOS ↔ BER, potentially with connection; airport/regional rail and local transit.
gates: Confirm friend and hosting dates.
Buy supplies ahead of Christmas closures.
Check Schengen entry and employer overseas work policy.
scenarios.note: A quiet friend-centered Christmas is more reliable than assuming attractions and shops operate normally.

scenarios.name: London · New Year
scenarios.route: BOS ↔ London, stay with friend; return after the initial holiday rush if quotes justify it.
gates: Confirm friend’s NYE plans.
Choose home gathering or reserve an event.
Confirm daily rabbit care and overseas work permission.
scenarios.note: NYE is not assumed cheaper: compare identical lengths and return dates. Jan 4–6 can be remote days if approved.

scenarios.name: Berlin · New Year
scenarios.route: BOS ↔ BER; public transit and hosted stay.
gates: Confirm friend’s NYE availability and preferred neighborhood.
Consider fireworks/crowd comfort.
Confirm daily care and overseas work permission.
scenarios.note: Reserve any paid party explicitly; groceries close Jan 1. Flight schedule and connections must be quoted.

scenarios.name: London · New Year together
scenarios.route: You: BOS ↔ London. Friend: BER ↔ London, dates agreed together.
gates: London host agrees to another guest.
Berlin friend confirms dates, UK entry eligibility and cost split.
Confirm daily care and remote work permission.
scenarios.note: Friend’s return transport is separate; set your subsidy below. Friend’s meals and local costs are not included in your total.

scenarios.name: Roanoke Christmas → London NYE
scenarios.route: BOS → ROA → London → BOS; compare protected multi-city ticket vs Boston return plus Europe round trip.
gates: Both hosts confirm dates.
Daily rabbit care covers the whole absence.
Allow at least a day between separate tickets or obtain protected connections.
Confirm employer permits overseas remote work.
scenarios.note: No rabbit travels on this baseline. Longer care costs can overwhelm flight savings; returning via Boston also costs time.

scenarios.name: London Christmas → Berlin NYE
scenarios.route: BOS → London → BER → BOS; compare open-jaw fare plus London–Berlin hop including bags and transfers.
gates: Both friends confirm hosting windows.
Confirm daily care for extended absence.
Verify UK and Schengen entry plus overseas work approval.
scenarios.note: Transport range covers all three air legs, not three return fares. Adds a travel day and more coordination.

scenarios.name: Roanoke · New Year
scenarios.route: BOS ↔ ROA with connection or long rail journey; hosts/taxi final mile.
gates: Christmas invitation does not imply NYE invitation: confirm hosts.
Confirm daily care and final-mile transport.
scenarios.note: Included for completeness; social availability is unknown.

scenarios.name: London · both holidays
scenarios.route: BOS ↔ London; airport rail on operating days, friend’s home as base.
gates: Confirm friend is available for Christmas.
Plan Dec 25 within walking distance or price a taxi.
Check passport, UK entry permission and employer overseas work policy.
scenarios.note: One return transatlantic trip with more friend time. Extra daily spending and rabbit care must be outweighed by fare savings or social value; host and work dates unconfirmed.
